text: Oh, absolutely. Why bother with the tedious, sweaty, and frankly unglamorous act of actual exercise when you can just achieve the physique of a Renaissance sculpture by aggressively shaking a piece of molded plastic? It’s the ultimate hack: ten minutes of wrist flicking, and suddenly you’re ready for the Olympics. Who needs calories, protein, or consistency when you have the sheer kinetic energy of a nervous tick? It’s not laziness; it’s efficiency. It’s not delusion; it’s innovation. The fitness industry has finally solved the problem of effort by removing the effort entirely, leaving us with the enviable physique of someone who has just finished a very intense game of Jenga.
